root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()` executes `cbor_array_get(item, 0)`, the `item` argument must satisfy the source-level precondition `cbor_isa_array(item)`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the vulnerable crashing path, `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()` receives a later outer `HASH` element for which `cbor_isa_array(item) == 0` and still calls `cbor_array_get(item, 0)`. In the fixed build the same malformed item reaches the guard but the protected call is skipped, while the same-length tuple perturbation shows the fixed parser still executes the protected call when `cbor_isa_array(item) == 1`.

nodes.state: At the `HASH` dispatch site, element 0 is itself a CBOR array, so `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file()` routes the full outer `pairs[i].value` array into `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash_array()`.
Inside `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash_array()`, the `item` parameter is the same outer `HASH` array value that `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file()` previously dispatched.
The `item` consumed by `cbor_array_get(item, 0)` is the exact outer-array element that `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash_array()` extracted as `value`.

edges.relation: The outer `HASH` array selected in `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_file()` is passed unchanged as the `item` argument to `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash_array()`.
The outer-array element extracted as `value = cbor_array_get(item, j)` is passed unchanged as the `item` argument to `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash()`, where `cbor_array_get(item, 0)` executes.
